description.en: Creates a low-detail cutscene model for a predefined "animal"-type NPC (a non-humanoid model loaded from a fixed file-naming convention based on its NPC number), and — unless suppressed — also creates its matching bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number used to build the model's file path (data/chr/model/rpg/npc/ca<npc_no>m.xc).
Optional; when true, skips creating the matching bustup portrait (defaults to false).
Optional; whether to create the shadow-casting variant (defaults to false).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail animal-type NPC model with its bustup portrait
local hAnimalL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_Animal("animalL", 5);
